lines.commandPath: d=$(jq -r '.workspace.current_dir // .cwd // empty'); [ -n "$d" ] && cd "$d" 2>/dev/null && g=$(git rev-parse --git-dir 2>/dev/null) && c=$(git rev-parse --git-common-dir 2>/dev/null) && case "$g" in "$c"/worktrees/*) printf '🌿%s' "${g#$c/worktrees/}";; esac; true

in=$(cat); f="$HOME/.cache/claude-rate-limits.json"; l="$HOME/.local/share/claude-rate-limits/history.jsonl"; sf="${l%/*}/sessions.json"; sid=$(printf '%s' "$in" | jq -r '.session_id // empty' 2>/dev/null); row=$(printf '%s' "$in" | jq -c 'select(.rate_limits.five_hour != null and .rate_limits.seven_day != null) | {ts: (now|floor), five_pct: .rate_limits.five_hour.used_percentage, five_reset: .rate_limits.five_hour.resets_at, week_pct: .rate_limits.seven_day.used_percentage, week_reset: .rate_limits.seven_day.resets_at}' 2>/dev/null); [ -n "$row" ] && { mkdir -p "${l%/*}" "${f%/*}"; last=$(tail -n 1 "$l" 2>/dev/null | jq -c . 2>/dev/null); ses=$(jq -c . "$sf" 2>/dev/null); [ -n "$ses" ] || ses='{}'; res=$(jq -nc --arg sid "$sid" --argjson a "$row" --argjson b "${last:-null}" --argjson s "$ses" 'def key: [.five_pct, .five_reset, .week_pct, .week_reset]; (if ($s | type) == "object" then $s else {} end) as $S0 | (($S0[$sid]? | objects) // null) as $prev | ($a | key) as $k | ($S0 + {($sid): {k: $k, ts: $a.ts}} | with_entries(select((.value | objects | .ts // 0) > ($a.ts - 86400)))) as $S1 | (($sid != "") and $prev != null and ($prev.k != $k)) as $fresh | if $b != null and ($a.five_reset < $b.five_reset or $a.week_reset < $b.week_reset) then {out: null, state: $S1, acc: ($b | .ts = $a.ts)} else (if $b == null or $fresh then $a else $b end) as $acc | {ts: $a.ts, five_pct: $acc.five_pct, five_reset: $acc.five_reset, week_pct: $acc.week_pct, week_reset: $acc.week_reset} as $o | {out: (if $b == null or ($o | del(.ts)) != ($b | del(.ts)) or ($a.ts - $b.ts) > 600 then $o else null end), state: $S1, acc: $o} end' 2>/dev/null); if [ -n "$res" ]; then printf '%s' "$res" | jq -c .state > "$sf.$$" 2>/dev/null && mv "$sf.$$" "$sf"; out=$(printf '%s' "$res" | jq -c '.out // empty'); [ -n "$out" ] && printf '%s\n' "$out" >> "$l"; printf '%s' "$res" | jq -ec '.acc | {rate_limits: {five_hour: {used_percentage: .five_pct, resets_at: .five_reset}, seven_day: {used_percentage: .week_pct, resets_at: .week_reset}}, ts: .ts}' > "$f.$$" 2>/dev/null && mv "$f.$$" "$f"; fi; } 2>/dev/null; rm -f "$f.$$" "$sf.$$" 2>/dev/null; true
